INSERT INTO logs
            (id, ts, severity, severity_text, service_name, body, trace_id, span_id, attributes)
        SELECT * FROM UNNEST(
            $1::uuid[], $2::timestamptz[], $3::int2[], $4::text[], $5::text[],
            $6::text[], $7::text[], $8::text[], $9::jsonb[]
        )
